tasks.analysis: Many animals rely on internal biological clocks to coordinate their behavior with environmental changes. These clocks allow organisms to detect variations in day length and adjust their physiology accordingly. As daylight increases, signals from the nervous system trigger the release of hormones that regulate processes such as growth, reproduction, and migration. These hormonal changes lead to observable shifts in behavior, including increased activity levels and seasonal breeding. In this way, biological clocks help animals synchronize their life cycles with predictable changes in their environment. 许多动物依赖体内的生物钟来协调自身行为与环境变化之间的关系。生物钟使生物体能够感知日照长度的变化，并相应地调节其生理状态。随着日照时间的增加，来自神经系统的信号会触发激素的释放，而这些激素会调控生长、繁殖和迁徙等过程。这些激素变化进一步导致行为上的可观察变化，例如活动水平的提高以及季节性繁殖。通过这种方式，生物钟帮助动物将其生命周期与环境中可预测的变化同步起来。
